title: Flexmaster — claimed by storm
description: CA · Manufacturing · Flexmaster, part of the Novaflex Group, specializes in a wide range of flexible ducting solutions including aluminum, stainless steel, and fabric ducting. Their product offerings also include innovative systems like the Platinum Flow gasketed duct and fume vent solutions. The company caters to various clients in the HVAC industry, providing essential accessories and insulation products. Flexmaster
